zh-Hans: 请在现有任务中运行本机计算及已安装技能，检查相同输入下的计算结果、停止响应、多核调整和文件/依赖保留。重点检查依赖包对符号链接文件的读取、清理，以及只读目录仍不能被写入；检查助手读取 Office 整页及局部图像的方向。运行环境无需重新下载或重置。性能提升随设备及负载变化。
en-US: Run local computation and installed skills in existing tasks. Check equal-input results, cancellation, online CPU changes and preservation of files/dependencies. Check dependency-package symlink reads/cleanup, retained read-only directory protection, and upright whole-page and cropped Office images read by the assistant. No runtime download or reset is needed. Performance varies by device and workload.
